card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis, or the letter n/N itself, right before a sample-size count like n=151 in clinical trial results. It also fires on a parenthesis after a study group or population that introduces a study name or dose.

modes.label: Parenthesis before n=
modes.description: Opening parenthesis after a treatment arm or table column label, just before n= or N=.

modes.label: The n in n=
modes.description: The letter n or N itself, before an equals sign and a patient count.

modes.label: Parenthesis before study label
modes.description: Parenthesis after a patient group, before a study name or dose.
